name: Shift Trails (COMPAS CEM)
description: Shift the starting sequence of a selection of trails in a topology diagram, or align every trail so that as many deviation edges as possible are direct.

inputParameters.name: origin_node_keys
inputParameters.description: The keys of the origin nodes of the trails to shift. Leave unconnected when auto_align is on.

inputParameters.name: sequences
inputParameters.description: The new starting sequence of every trail to shift. The last sequence repeats for the remaining trails. Leave unconnected when auto_align is on.

inputParameters.name: auto_align
inputParameters.description: Whether to shift every trail so that as many deviation edges as possible are direct, so that the topology solves in a single iteration. Between every pair of linked trails, the shift most of their edges agree on wins, and every group of linked trails starts again at sequence 0. Edges that no shift makes direct stay indirect, with a warning. Defaults to False.

outputParameters.name: topology
outputParameters.description: A copy of the topology diagram with its trails shifted.
